summary: Ares Strategic Income Fund filed an 8-K reporting routine operational items: an unregistered sale of 627,661 Class I shares for $16.7 million at NAV ($26.67/share as of July 31, 2026), NAV disclosure, and declared monthly distributions. No special-situation event (acquisition, tender, restructuring, etc.) is present. The unregistered sale is a routine continuous offering under exemptions, and distribution declarations are ordinary for a closed-end fund. No board recommendation, deal terms, or strategic actions are included. What to watch: none—this is a standard periodic filing.
